name: os_sr_avchk

actions.operation: Read created os_sr_avq row and required inputs only
Read active referenced TA and, for Onsite only, Location; fail closed if missing/inactive/invalid; retain required reference snapshots in flow memory only
Call the single Graph getSchedule connector operation for TA and, only for Onsite, room
Reject missing/error source entries or malformed/wrong-length availabilityView; persist no raw provider data
Compute deterministic slots using the offline os_sr_avqg library contract

Before every terminal write, re-read TA and, for Onsite only, Location; apply ReferenceDriftPolicy.BeforeTerminalWrite to the values used for Graph; any relevant drift or failed re-read overrides the proposed result with Failed, slots [], and REFERENCE_CHANGED
Update only state, reason, error, computed slots, queried-at, and expiry

referenceDrift.normalization: Trim and lowercase invariant; use these exact normalized addresses for Graph and the comparison.
referenceDrift.storage: Memory only. No mailbox snapshot, raw Graph data, or display-name snapshot is persisted or logged. Secure inputs/outputs on reference reads, Graph actions and snapshot/comparison actions; no raw payload in failure diagnostics.
referenceDrift.recovery: No automatic replacement query or retry after drift; user may initiate a new query.
referenceDrift.boundary: The re-read is immediately before the terminal write, not a distributed lock or a booking guarantee.

retry.429: Honor Retry-After with at most two retries for this idempotent read, and only while inside an overall request deadline.
retry.ambiguousTimeout: No blind repeat. Complete the row as Failed with GRAPH_TIMEOUT if no safe response is available.
retry.401_403_404: Fail closed as GRAPH_AUTH, GRAPH_PERMISSION, or MAILBOX_NOT_FOUND; no retry.

forbiddenOperations: Candidate Status History create or update
